name: Sons of the Mechanic
lore: Where flesh fails under the grind of endless war, the Legion of the Mechanic replaces it with chronal-forged iron. Their Primal Mechanic teaches that a warrior's true strength is measured in unbroken circuits and remorseless logic: every fallen brother rebuilt harder than before.

rules.name: Iron Calculus
rules.lore: The Sons of the Mechanic fight as a single machine: cold, precise, and unwilling to yield even a fraction of ground without extracting a toll in return.
rules.text: Each time a +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit from your army is selected as the target of an attack, until the end of that attack sequence models in that unit have !Feel No Pain 6+!. If the attacking unit is your army's Vow of Eternity target, that !Feel No Pain! is 5+ instead.

strategems.name: Iron Volley Protocol
strategems.target: Your +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit being Activated that did not Advance this Activation
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, ranged weapons equipped by models in the target unit have +[Heavy]+ and +1 to their =hand-fist= Strength trait.

strategems.name: Replace the Weakness
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit has completed its Shoot or Fight attacks
strategems.target: A +Shattered Legions+ unit that had one or more models destroyed by that attack
strategems.effect: Return one destroyed model to the target unit with 1 HP remaining (it must be set up in Unit Coherency). In addition, until the end of the Battle Round the target unit has !Feel No Pain 6+!.

strategems.name: Logic Lock
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, each time a model in the target unit makes a ranged attack against a +Monster+, +Vehicle+, or your Vow of Eternity target, improve that attack's =shield-minus= Armor Break by 1.

spells.name: Cogitate Weakness
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18". Until the end of the Battle Round, ranged attacks made by friendly +Shattered Legions+ units against that unit have +[Ignores Cover]+.

spells.name: Forge Mantle
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Legion of the Mechanic+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, models in that unit have an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save of 5+ and !Feel No Pain 6+!.

spells.name: Severance Pulse
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18". That unit suffers d3 Mortal Damage. Until the end of the Battle Round, that unit cannot benefit from the +Lone Operative+ rule and does not receive the benefit of Cover from Terrain.

upgrades.name: Forge-Born Scion
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Ironclad Frame
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ has !Feel No Pain 6+!. If it already had !Feel No Pain 6+!, it gains !Feel No Pain 5+! instead.

upgrades.name: Logic of Annihilation
upgrades.text: Ranged weapons equipped by your +Warlord+ (and by models in its attached unit, if any) have +1 to their =bow-arrow= Ranged Skill trait.
